attempts.evidence: I ran `bash tests/scout_lugstore.sh`. All six 'ok' steps printed, then 'PASS: scout ignores the lug store files and still catches other changes'. The tool output did not display exit codes, but the run completed with PASS. I ran `/usr/bin/python3 -m pytest -q`, which printed '7 passed in 3.17s'. One note on F-002: a .pytest_cache folder is now in the worktree. It is untracked and not git-ignored. It most likely came from my own pytest run, because the allowed command cannot take `-p no:cacheprovider`. It is not in the commit, and it should be deleted before anything is committed.
